pre_condition: seconds is None or a numeric value representing a duration in seconds.
post_condition: If seconds is None, returns the placeholder string "—". Otherwise returns a human-readable string decomposing the duration into hours (suffix "h"), minutes (suffix "m"), and seconds (suffix "s") components separated by single spaces. The representation starts from the most significant nonzero component: when the duration reaches at least one hour, all three components appear; when at least one minute but under one hour, only minutes and seconds appear; when under one minute, only seconds appear. When multiple components are present, all components after the first are zero-padded to two digits. Component values derive from integer-truncated seconds.
